title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming parity across Python/TS/Go (v1.153.0)
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: bring parity and ergonomics improvements to all official SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go). This PR unifies the auth handling (consistent token refresh flows), standardizes retry semantics (exponential backoff + jitter with configurable policies), and completes streaming API parity and ergonomics changes across languages. Summary of work: 1) Core auth: centralize token refresh/caching behavior and expose a lightweight AuthProvider interface across SDKs to support both short-lived credentials and static tokens. 2) Retries: introduce a retry policy object with default exponential backoff, idempotency-aware retries, and per-call overrides. 3) Streaming: align TS/Go streaming client APIs with Python ergonomics (context manager / async iterator parity), fix cancellation semantics and reconnect/backoff behavior. 4) Docs and examples: migration guide and updated changelogs for v1.153.0. Checklist: [x] Python auth refactor and unit tests [x] TS retry + streaming parity and e2e tests [x] Go client auth + streaming integration tests [x] Docs/migration guide [x] Changelog/version bump [x] CI flakes addressed Notes: kept changes minimal in surface area for customers: defaults preserved unless they opt into new RetryPolicy or AuthProvider. See linked Linear tickets ENG-2345 and ENG-2390 for rollout plan and API compat notes.
